selfTrademark.hookTitle: Complex trademark filing, now made easy
selfTrademark.hookDesc: You only need two things to start a trademark filing: your brand name and business description.
selfTrademark.hookDesc2: We'll take care of the rest.
selfTrademark.hookPoint1Desc: We guide you with simple questions instead of complex classification codes.
selfTrademark.hookPoint2Desc: We automatically organize designated goods candidates based on your business.
selfTrademark.hookPoint3Desc: File your trademark yourself with the auto-organized guide, or request expert assistance.

selfTrademark.disclaimer: The automated recommendations provided by this service do not guarantee filing approval. Separate review is required for identical/similar trademarks, distinctiveness, and appropriateness of designated goods.

selfTrademark.guideSubtitle: We've prepared a guide based on your selected information.
selfTrademark.guideFeeNote: * Based on electronic filing with designated names. Actual fees are confirmed at filing.
selfTrademark.guideSec1Desc: Before filing, make sure no identical or similar trademark is already registered.
selfTrademark.guideSec1Step1Desc: Search using your brand name and similar terms to check for prior trademarks.
selfTrademark.guideSec1Step2: Also search for international trademarks (Madrid Protocol)
selfTrademark.guideSec1Step2Desc: Check if any foreign brands are registered in Korea.
selfTrademark.guideSec1Note: Prior trademark searches may require specialized knowledge. If uncertain, we recommend expert review.
selfTrademark.guideSec2Desc: To file a trademark, you need a 9-digit applicant code issued by KIPO. Once obtained, it can be used for all IP filings.
selfTrademark.guideSec2Method1Desc: Log in to patent.go.kr with a digital certificate → Go to application forms → Submit Applicant Number Issuance Request. Issued immediately or within 1-2 business days.
selfTrademark.guideSec2Method2Desc: Complete the applicant number request form and submit to KIPO (Daejeon) or a regional IP center.
selfTrademark.guideSec2DocsIndividual: Individual: ID copy, applicant number request form
selfTrademark.guideSec2DocsCorp: Corporation: business registration copy, corporate seal certificate (or corporate registry), request form
selfTrademark.guideSec3Check1: Trademark name (text) or logo image file (JPG/PNG/PDF)
selfTrademark.guideSec3Check2: Applicant code (Patent Customer Number) — see step 2 above
selfTrademark.guideSec3Check3: Designated goods/services list (see top of this guide)
selfTrademark.guideSec3Check4: Filing fee (46,000 KRW per class for electronic filing with designated names)
selfTrademark.guideSec3Step1: Log in to patent.go.kr with a digital certificate
selfTrademark.guideSec3Step2: Fill out the trademark application form
selfTrademark.guideSec3Step3: Enter the designated goods codes (refer to the list above)
selfTrademark.guideSec3Step4: Pay the filing fee and note your application number
selfTrademark.guideSec5Item1: Examination period: approximately 8–14 months after filing
selfTrademark.guideSec5Item2: If you receive an office action, submit a response within the deadline.
selfTrademark.guideSec5Item3: If rejected, consider filing a trial or re-application.
selfTrademark.guideSec5Item4: After registration, renewal is required every 10 years.
selfTrademark.guideSec6Desc: If you find similar trademarks during your prior trademark search, we recommend filing through a patent attorney.
selfTrademark.guideSec6Desc2: If you find it difficult to handle the filing process yourself, consider our filing service.
